source.comparison: Public JSONC parsed without comments/trailing commas compared against a fresh read of the local brarchive entry, not a cache derived from the public file.

profile.name: Classic desktop right pane
profile.recipeBook: Recipe book and external toolbar are sibling controls of this right pane. They are not faked inside these components.
profile.closeButton: Both furnace.right_panel and crafting.player_inventory set common_panel.$show_close_button=false. Processing components exclude onClose/closeLabel and do not render an internal X.

fuel.derivation: Same nested 16x16 panel; fuel18x18 right_middle offset[-20,19].

flame.derivation: flame_panel13x13 default center in nested16x16, offset[-21,0].

result.count: Uses the existing 18x18 game item panel centered in the 26x26 cell. ResultSlot.large therefore insets count right by8 CSS px and moves durability to [14,35].

inventory.derivation: workbench inventory_label offset[-21,72] + parent[29,0] =>[8,72]; the actual grid still comes from common.inventory_panel_bottom_half at root y83.

webSpatialNavigationInference.result.ArrowLeft: input[5], the closest input-cell center to result center in this source geometry

publicApi.ProcessingArrow.progress: 0..1 completion; 0 empty, 1 full; reveal full-size active PNG from left to right.
publicApi.FuelIndicator.progress: 0..1 remaining; 0 empty, 1 full; reveal full-size full-flame PNG from bottom upward.

progress.geometry: All source pixels remain nearest-neighbor at GUI2; active layers always retain44x30 or26x26 bounds. CSS clip paths crop the layer; they never resize it to the ratio.
progress.rounding: No extra custom 2-CSS-pixel floor is imposed. At .5 the26px flame reveal is13 CSS px. This is the public Web API convention, not a proof of native #clip_ratio direction or pixel rounding.

behavior.items: All input/fuel/result arrays are controlled data; components do not calculate recipes, burn durations, smelting speeds or item transfers.
behavior.callbacks: Primary and secondary actions are forwarded. ResultSlot prevents result taking when empty/unavailable while retaining focus/hover.
behavior.closeButton: Furnace and CraftingTable exclude onClose/closeLabel from their public props and explicitly override onClose to undefined after forwarded props at runtime, matching the source right-pane $show_close_button:false.
behavior.keyboard: RecipeGrid reuses InventoryGrid roving focus/disabled-cell navigation. Explicit game focus overrides are implemented, and extra nearest-neighbor Web choices are distinguished above.

evidenceLimits: Source box mathematics and original PNG equality are proved separately from a whole-frame native screenshot.
Native default panel sizing, text baseline, pixel snapping and clip_ratio backend semantics still need same-state game capture.
The recipe-book pane and toolbar are outside the implemented right-pane profile.
Current local game launch is blocked by Xbox Live0x80004005; no complete native screenshot acceptance is claimed.

verification.integratedTypeScript: npm run typecheck passed after the runtime close-button guard; includes core and demo TypeScript.
